Key points
• Globalization has resulted in dramatic shifts in diet and physical activity patterns that promote obesity and chronic diseases.
• Diets have shifted from high-ﬁber and low-processed sugar to high-fat and high in processed foods.
• Activity patterns have shifted as technology has globalized and communities and work forces are more sedentary than ever
before.
• More people than ever are overweight or obese and the prevalence of chronic diseases is increasing rapidly in lower income
countries.
